args.prompt:
Create ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 TRANSPARENT PNG KFB ink monster character sheet, EXACTLY SIX UNIQUE CLASSIC FAMILY-DOCTOR / GENERAL-PRACTICE / INTERNAL-MEDICINE ARCHETYPES in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Away from emergency/rescue: familiar civilian consulting-room doctors, white coats, old-fashioned head mirrors, simple classic examination props, absurd weird expressive personalities, with warmth. Two female-read. No real physician likeness or organization logos.
Two input images STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first for whole rounded dark charcoal-violet ink body, rich soft plasticine and sculpted lids; second for beautifully crafted clay wood/metal/cloth/glass/leather props. NEW actors, not edits or copied reference faces.
Each actor ONE COMPLETE UPRIGHT FOOTLESS continuous charcoal-black ink splat with subtle deep purple sheen, thick soft asymmetric rounded lobes, huge face directly in goo, tiny rounded goo hands, a few contained ink drops. NO human torso/legs/feet, bust, realistic human head, fur or angular stone body. Shared WHITE DOCTOR COAT cues: short OPEN white lapel/side panels, one small coat pocket and white cuff accents, simple muted shirt/tie insert. Coat never covers full body or creates a long robe; continuous ink face/belly/lower goo lobes clearly visible, most body remains ink. No teal scrubs, rescue helmets, military style or full human-shaped suits. Fine soft hand-sculpted plasticine, fingerprints, rounded volumes and selective seams/wear, weird offbeat clay cartoon rather than Pixar humans.
ALL actual EYES WHITE/IVORY sclera around distinct small RED iris and BLACK pupil, thick purple-black sculpted lids. All six faces/mouths/eyes uncovered. Head mirrors are SILVER METAL DISCS with a small plain dark center hole attached to forehead band, ABOVE BROWS, never over an actual eye. No glasses, masks or goggles hiding expression. Six different face proportions/lids/brows/gaze/mouth/lip actions; irregular ivory teeth, no repeated open grins or dangling tongues.
Props are simple stylized role icons, NOT clinical instructions. No patients, wounds, blood, needle insertion, procedures, medicine names, labels, letters, numbers or floating punctuation.

TOP LEFT — MALE-READ OLD-SCHOOL COUNTRY GP. Broad low heavy pear blob with one sagging crown loop, two short ivory clay hair tufts at face sides, WHITE coat lapels and little muted burgundy tie. One clearly visible round SILVER FOREHEAD MIRROR on black band tilted UP above both eyebrows. Gruff kindly certainty: one white eye enormous, other half-lidded sideways, one brow lifted questioningly, huge crooked CLOSED lower lip and one large offset upper tooth. Holds ONE short WOODEN TONGUE DEPRESSOR at own belly and ONE small antique brown LEATHER DOCTOR BAG by sturdy handle, plain brass clasp, no logos. No examination of mouth or neighbor, no long white beard.
TOP MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ PATIENT FAMILY PHYSICIAN. Wide wavy-edged upright ink dumpling with two small curled crown lobes, one short dark clay side curl, subtle lashes, short open white coat panels with pastel-green collar. Patient affectionate scepticism: uneven white eyes look SIDEWAYS, one lid low and opposite brow raised, almost CLOSED crooked warm smile with one tiny lower tooth. Both hands hold ONE SIMPLE STETHOSCOPE at belly: two short silver ear tubes with rounded tips join one continuous black Y-shaped tube ending in ONE round silver chest disc. A tiny blank paper corner in white pocket only, no clipboard, extra bag or full uniform.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ METICULOUS INTERNIST. Tall thin hooked bean blob, three small offset crown drops, tiny dark clay side hair curl, short open WHITE lapels with muted blue shirt insert. Very worried analytical concentration: huge unequal white eyes look DOWN, inner brows raised, tightly pinched asymmetrical mouth and one central tooth, protruding heavy lower lip. Holds ONE classic MANUAL BLOOD-PRESSURE KIT low at belly: small folded dark cuff, one round SILVER DIAL with simple unnumbered tick marks and one black RUBBER BULB linked by one short obvious black tube. Coherent chunky simplified kit, no text/numbers, long hose or computer.
BOTTOM LEFT — FEMALE-READ STRICT THROAT/GENERAL EXAMINER. Tall wavy pear splat, two small dark clay braid ends, subtle lashes, short WHITE coat lapels/cuff and one tiny peach collar insert. One second SMALL SILVER HEAD MIRROR attached to ivory band above one eyebrow but fully above both eyes, disc angled up and out, small dark center hole. Stern theatrical insistence: one eye round and one squinting toward viewer, hard asymmetrical brow, shallow sideways open mouth with three uneven clenched teeth and thick lower lip. Holds ONE small plain SILVER PENLIGHT pointing DOWN and ONE flat chunky WOODEN TONGUE DEPRESSOR across own belly. No own-mouth examination or light beam, mask or hidden eyes.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — MALE-READ REFLEX-AND-CHECKUP ENTHUSIAST. Broad near-square soft lobed blob, one short curled crown lobe, clean short WHITE coat shoulder panels and a tiny mustard bow tie, no head mirror. Ridiculously delighted concentration, one white eye wide looking UP and other narrowed in anticipation, one high curved brow, lopsided shallow toothy smile with two tiny widely spaced teeth. Holds ONE SHORT REFLEX HAMMER with black triangular rubber head and thick steel handle, and ONE SHORT FAT SILVER TUNING FORK with TWO rounded prongs, both held low at own belly. No tapping anyone, knee/limb, motion lines or testing diagram.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ ABSENT-MINDED PRESCRIPTION GP. Tall top-heavy crooked ink bean with two droopy crown lobes, two short grey clay moustache tips framing mouth, short open WHITE lapels with faded lilac collar, one pocket with ONE blunt red pencil tip. Weary distracted doubt: unequal white eyes roll UP in different directions, brow corners high, enormous CLOSED crooked pout with one irregular lower tooth. One hand holds ONE small cream PRESCRIPTION PAD completely BLANK, other holds ONE absurdly thick short FOUNTAIN PEN with rounded black barrel and simple brass nib aimed at own blank pad. No writing, drug names, printed medical symbols, giant scroll, paperwork pile or human hands.

Layout: six LARGE complete self-contained actors in regular3x2 visual grid, similar substantial body height across both rows. Whole silhouettes450-465px in512pxlogical cells, ample outer margins and32-40px clear row gaps. Contain all mirrors/coat tails/tubes/bags/tools/pads/pens/droplets in OWN cells. No overlapping/touching neighbors, cropped details or miniature bottom row. Coat props never overwhelm huge expressive face and bouncy ink body. No gridlines, background gradient, floor, shadow discs, checkerboard, halo, text or watermark. True alpha-zero transparent surroundings with opaque character interiors and clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio light on figures only.
